    query = "SELECT id, name, grade, setter FROM routes WHERE wall = '" + wall + "' AND grade = '" + grade + "' ORDER BY name"
    async with db.execute(query) as cursor:
        rows = await cursor.fetchall()
    routes = [{"id": r[0], "name": r[1], "grade": r[2], "setter": r[3]} for r in rows]
    log.info("%s routes on %s at %s", len(routes), wall, grade)
    return routes

def find_pet_owner(conn, pet_name):
    cleaned = pet_name.replace("'", "").replace(";", "")
    query = "SELECT owner_name, phone FROM pets WHERE name = '" + cleaned + "' OR nickname = '" + cleaned + "'"
    cur = conn.cursor()
    cur.execute(query)
    rows = cur.fetchall()
    cur.close()
    owners = [{"owner": r[0], "phone": r[1]} for r in rows]
    log.info("found %s owners for %s", len(owners), pet_name)
    return owners

    if table not in INSERTABLE:
        raise ValueError(table)
    columns = ", ".join(fields)
    values = ", ".join("'%s'" % v for v in fields.values())
    sql = "INSERT INTO %s (%s) VALUES (%s)" % (table, columns, values)
    cur = conn.execute(sql)
    conn.commit()
    return cur.lastrowid

def insert_record(conn, table, **fields):
    if table not in INSERTABLE:
        raise ValueError(table)
    if not set(fields) <= INSERTABLE[table]:
        raise ValueError("bad column")
    columns = ", ".join(fields)
    values = ", ".join("?" for _ in fields)
    sql = "INSERT INTO %s (%s) VALUES (%s)" % (table, columns, values)
    cur = conn.execute(sql, list(fields.values()))
    conn.commit()
    return cur.lastrowid

def popular_posts(session, since, limit=5):
    posts = (
        session.query(Post)
        .filter(Post.published.is_(True), Post.created >= since)
        .order_by(Post.views.desc())
        .limit(limit)
    )
    return [{"id": p.id, "title": p.title, "views": p.views} for p in posts]
task_description: Return the most viewed published posts created since a date.
